parameters.query:
SELECT code, name, description
FROM time_categories
WHERE is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY code;

SELECT category_code, example_text
FROM time_category_examples
WHERE is_active = TRUE
ORDER BY category_code, id;

-- Find the end_time of the last confirmed slot for this date,
-- to chain duration-only slots after it.
SELECT MAX(end_time) AS last_end
FROM time_slots
WHERE slot_date = $1::date
  AND status = 'confirmed'
  AND end_time IS NOT NULL;

WITH new_batch AS (
  INSERT INTO time_message_batches (
    telegram_chat_id, telegram_user_id, telegram_message_id,
    raw_text, batch_date, status
  )
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::date, 'pending_clarification')
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO time_pending_clarifications (
  batch_id, telegram_chat_id, telegram_user_id,
  original_text, question_text, status
)
SELECT id, $1, $2, $4, $6, 'pending'
FROM new_batch
RETURNING batch_id;

-- All in one trip: today totals, week totals, daily goals, weekly goals.
WITH today AS (
  SELECT $1::date AS d
),
week_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    (DATE_TRUNC('week', $1::date)::date) AS w_start,
    (DATE_TRUNC('week', $1::date)::date + INTERVAL '6 days')::date AS w_end
)
SELECT 'today_total' AS kind, c.code AS category_code, c.name AS category_name,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.duration_minutes), 0)::int AS total_minutes,
       NULL::date AS period_start, NULL::date AS period_end
FROM time_categories c
LEFT JOIN time_slots s
  ON s.category_code = c.code AND s.status = 'confirmed' AND s.slot_date = $1::date
GROUP BY c.code, c.name
UNION ALL
SELECT 'week_total', c.code, c.name,
       COALESCE(SUM(s.duration_minutes), 0)::int,
       wb.w_start, wb.w_end
FROM time_categories c
CROSS JOIN week_bounds wb
LEFT JOIN time_slots s
  ON s.category_code = c.code AND s.status = 'confirmed'
     AND s.slot_date BETWEEN wb.w_start AND wb.w_end
GROUP BY c.code, c.name, wb.w_start, wb.w_end
UNION ALL
SELECT 'goal_daily', g.category_code, c.name, g.goal_minutes,
       g.date_from, g.date_to
FROM time_goals g
JOIN time_categories c ON c.code = g.category_code
WHERE g.is_active = TRUE AND g.goal_type = 'daily'
  AND $1::date BETWEEN g.date_from AND g.date_to
UNION ALL
SELECT 'goal_weekly', g.category_code, c.name, g.goal_minutes,
       g.date_from, g.date_to
FROM time_goals g
JOIN time_categories c ON c.code = g.category_code
WHERE g.is_active = TRUE AND g.goal_type = 'weekly'
  AND $1::date BETWEEN g.date_from AND g.date_to;

INSERT INTO time_dashboard_messages
  (telegram_chat_id, telegram_message_id, dashboard_scope)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'main')
ON CONFLICT (telegram_chat_id, dashboard_scope)
DO UPDATE SET
  telegram_message_id = EXCLUDED.telegram_message_id,
  updated_at = NOW();
